versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the mirror-download skill.
- Automatically detects download/access issues with HuggingFace or GitHub and instantly switches to a fast domestic mirror (hf-mirror, ModelScope, GitCode, etc.)—no repeated retries on the original site.
- Provides quick connectivity testing to select the fastest available mirror source.
- Includes detailed step-by-step instructions for mirrored downloads of models, datasets, and code repositories.
- Offers ready-to-use scripts, error diagnostics, and ID conversion tables for smooth operation and troubleshooting.
